title: 2-fibre products of algebraic stacks over a stack with space-representable diagonal are algebraic

standard_prerequisites.name: Diagonal criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Isom sheaves of algebraic-stack inputs are algebraic spaces.

core_obligations: Condition (1): the 2-fibre product is a stack in groupoids by the Stacks closure lemma.

Condition (2): write u = (x, y, alpha) and v = (x', y', alpha'); the explicit cartesian square identifies Isom(u, v) with the fibre product of Isom(x, x'), Isom(y, y') and Isom(f(x), g(y')), all algebraic spaces by the diagonal assumption; verify the square commutes componentwise.

Condition (3): the 2-fibre product of the presentations over Z is representable by an algebraic space F (diagonal assumption); the induced morphism to X x_Z Y is a composition of base changes of x and y, hence surjective smooth; choose a scheme W -> F surjective etale and compose.
proof_roadmap: Definition conditions (1)-(3); Isom cartesian square with componentwise commutativity; presentation assembly with an etale chart.
difficulty_reason: A three-condition verification with a genuine Isom fibre-product computation and a presentation assembly.
